	local v14 = math.floor(v13) + 1
	local v15 = v_u_1.MaxLevel

end
function v_u_1.HeistXP(p16, p17, p18, p19) -- name: HeistXP
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v20 = v_u_1.XP
	local v21 = tonumber(p16) or 0
	local v22 = math.max(0, v21)
	local v23 = tonumber(p17) or 1
	local v24 = math.max(1, v23)
	local v25 = v20.HeistLoot
	local v26 = v22 / v24
	local v27 = v25 * math.min(1, v26) * (v20.HeistDifficulty[p18] or 1)
	if v24 <= v22 then
		v27 = v27 * v20.HeistAllLoot
	end
	if not p19 then
		v27 = v27 * v20.HeistCaught
	end
	local v28 = v27 + 0.5
	return math.floor(v28)
end

function v_u_1.RewardText(p51) -- name: RewardText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if not p51 then
		return ""
	end
	if p51.Type == "Gold" then
		local v52 = p51.Amount
		if v52 < 1000 then
			v56 = tostring(v52)
			return v56 .. " Gold"
		end
		local v53 = v52 / 1000
		if v53 ~= math.floor(v53) then
			v55 = string.format("%.1f", v53)
			v56 = v55 .. "k"
			return v56 .. " Gold"
		end
		local v54 = math.floor(v53)
		local v55 = tostring(v54)
		if v55 then
			v56 = v55 .. "k"
			return v56 .. " Gold"
		end
		v55 = string.format("%.1f", v53)
		local v56 = v55 .. "k"
		return v56 .. " Gold"
	end
	if p51.Type ~= "Diamonds" then
		if p51.Type == "BagRoll" then
			return "Bag Roll x" .. p51.Amount
		end
		if p51.Type == "Tool" then
			local v57 = p51.Name == "GrappleHook" and "Grapple Hook" or p51.Name

local function v_u_163(p148, p149) -- name: rebalanceExisting
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_147, (copy) v_u_109
	local v150 = (p148.QuestBalanceVersion or 0) < v_u_2.BalanceVersion
	for _, v151 in ipairs({ "Daily", "Weekly" }) do

				if v153 then
					v156 = p148.PendingQuestSkips[v151]
				else
					v156 = v153
				end
				if v156 then

						v156 = v156.Target == v155.Target
					else
						v156 = false
					end

					v155.BalanceVersion = v_u_2.BalanceVersion
					v150 = true

						continue

					local v158 = v_u_2.GenerateTask(v155.Type, v157, v151, v_u_147(v155), p149, v153, v155.BuyIn ~= nil)
					if not v155.Completed then

						v155.DailyTarget = v160
						if v_u_109(v155.Type, v157, v151, v153, p148) then
							v155.ExtraReq = v158.ExtraReq
						end

						local v162 = v155.Target
						v155.Progress = math.clamp(v161, 0, v162)
						v155.Completed = v155.Progress >= v155.Target
					end

					v155.BalanceVersion = v_u_2.BalanceVersion

	end

function v_u_2.Initialize(p171, p172, p173) -- name: Initialize

	local v174 = p172 or os.time()
	local v175 = p173 or math.random
	if (p171.QuestBoardVersion or 0) < v_u_2.Version then

		if not v176.Daily and v174 < (p171.DailyReset or 0) then
			for _, v178 in ipairs(v_u_2.Types) do

				end

				local v181
				if type(v180) == "number" and v180 == v180 then
					v181 = math.abs(v180) < (1 / 0)
				else

				end
				if not v181 or v179.Required <= 0 then
					continue
				end
				local v182 = v179.Got
				local v183
				if type(v182) == "number" and v182 == v182 then

				else

				end

				end
				local v184 = v179.Reward
				if type(v184) ~= "table" then
					continue
				end
				local v185 = v178 == "Steal_Minimal_Worth"
				local v186 = v185 and 1 or v179.Required
				local v187
				if v185 then
					v187 = v179.Got >= v179.Required and 1 or 0
				else
					local v188 = v179.Got

local v_u_842 = nil
local function v847() -- name: refreshFlash
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_842, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_4
	local v843 = (v_u_6:GetAttribute("FlashedUntil") or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if v_u_842 then
		v_u_842:Cancel()
		v_u_842 = nil
	end
	if v843 <= 0 then
		v_u_14.Visible = false
	else
		local v844 = v843 * (v_u_14:GetAttribute("HoldShare") or 0.45)
		v_u_14.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		v_u_14.Visible = true
		local v_u_845 = v_u_4:Create(v_u_14, TweenInfo.new(v843 - v844, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In, 0, false, v844), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
		})
		v_u_842 = v_u_845
		v_u_845.Completed:Connect(function(p846)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_842, (copy) v_u_845, (ref) v_u_14
			if p846 == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and v_u_842 == v_u_845 then
				v_u_14.Visible = false
			end
		end)
		v_u_845:Play()
	end
end
v_u_6:GetAttributeChangedSignal("FlashedUntil"):Connect(v847)
